title: 611. Split Concatenated Strings

examples.explanation: Reverse both then cut at z.
Best rotation of the reversed loop.

hints: For every string except the one holding the cut, the better of it and its reversal is always optimal, so normalise those first.
Fix which original string contains the cut, build the middle from the other normalised strings, then try every split of the cut string in both orientations.
Compare all candidates and keep the lexicographic maximum.
